requirements.requirement: Separate support page and main-app Support button open the same support service/tickets; independent launch and non-AI operation survive main app shutdown.
Real persistent ticket creation, list, conversation/follow-up and state distinguish answered from solved; reload/restart preserves history.
RAG retrieves relevant product FAQ/documentation with paths/versions and citations; no hardcoded answer or whole-FAQ-only prompt.
Actual SDK MCP tools/list and tools/call retrieve bounded current user/ticket JSON context from separate server.
Full model answers depend on correct ticket facts and earlier attempts; same question differs for known diagnostic cases.
Demo users are clearly synthetic; server-owned scope checks every relevant API/tool and blocks foreign ticket access.
Unknown facts/context are not invented; bounded follow-up and escalation, stale ticket/version results not treated as current.
Selected Local and DeepSeek both work with preserved parameters and no hidden provider fallback; raw final answers and settings identity retained.
Visible wait/streaming, Stop, queue and restart/late-result guards; model code/content not executed in browser or host.
Telegram support/escalation/report goes only to saved owner with explicit action/opt-in and honest delivery state.
First run, separate support data and MCP lifecycles are reproducible using existing trusted entrypoint without dependencies/keys forcing non-AI features closed.
Existing D31/D32 UI, APIs, persisted user data, provider settings and review/help functionality preserved.
Complete SPEC/PLAN/ACCEPTANCE, readiness and architecture/spec independent reviews before implementation; incremental single writer.
Detailed Russian teaching DOCX in Current task explains theory and actual support implementation, data senders/receivers, JSON/MCP/RAG, models, Telegram/GitHub role and week7, with real screenshots.
Published reproducible code and detailed wide high-quality MP4 in Current task demonstrate every D33 requirement, both entries, RAG/MCP context and useful answers.
Full independent acceptance, sanitized commit/push+remote verification and clean task scope; one final truthful owner Telegram notification after completion.

independent_tester.note: Independent full113 was followed by independently executed2 actual SDK tests. Do not represent this as an independent full115 rerun.

behavior_evidence: Both entries open same support service and saved tickets
Main process stopped: Support FAQ and ticket creation remained operational; borrowed model process preserved
Real SDK stdio tools/list and get_user_context/get_ticket_context, fresh versioned immutable JSON, no direct JSON fallback
Full live Local and DeepSeek answers compared across4diagnostic scenarios
Stop during actual provider request remains cancelled with no late answer; explicit Retry new run
Changed facts preserve historical answer warning and cause fresh MCP snapshot
Synthetic owner scope/stale-tab rejection, manual mode under invalid AI config
Explicit Telegram summary acknowledged once; repeated click deduplicated; escalation without extra notification
Main D31 real Local /help git branch and D32 PR context regression preserved
limitations: Synthetic local demo personas are not production authentication or a live external CRM.
Completed inference/citations never automatically mean verified quality or resolved ticket.
Current passing cases do not guarantee all future model answers. Qualifications and initial failure are in live-model-comparison.json.
Final publication/remote clean-worktree and completion notification are checked after commit; their private receipts are not fabricated in this pre-publication file.
